name: tradingcalendars
description: Business days, T+N settlement dates and financial holidays for FX, banks, payment systems and exchanges, with live market status.

interface.longDescription:
TradingCalendars answers financial calendar questions from maintained data instead of guesses: FX market holidays and currency settlement (non-clearing) days for 50 currencies, bank holidays for 69 financial centres, 29 payment systems (TARGET2, Fedwire, CHAPS and others), and trading and settlement holidays with half days and early closes for 61 exchanges. Each calendar is built from official sources.

Ask it whether a date is a business day across several calendars, what the T+1 or T+2 settlement or payment date is, or how many business days lie between two dates. Every answer names the holidays it skipped, so you can check it. It also tells you whether an exchange is open right now, with the next open and close.

Useful for payments and treasury teams, brokers, fund operations and developers scheduling around market closures.

All tools are read-only. Without sign-in, data covers last year through next year and a daily number of calls shared by all ChatGPT users.
defaultPrompt: What's the T+2 settlement date for a EUR/USD trade done on 23 December?
Is the New York Stock Exchange open right now, and when does it close today?
Which days close TARGET2 in the next 90 days?

positive.description: FX settlement date (T+2) across two currencies
positive.prompt: What's the T+2 settlement date for a EUR/USD trade done on 23 December 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Monday 28 December 2026, naming the skipped days: 25 December (Christmas Day, both USD.FX and EUR.FX) and the 26-27 December weekend.

positive.description: Business day check across several calendars
positive.prompt: Is Monday 28 December 2026 a business day for both USD FX and TARGET2 payments?
positive.expected_behavior: Yes: 28 December 2026 is open in both USD.FX and TARGET2.PAY.

positive.prompt: Is the New York Stock Exchange open right now, and when does it next open or close?
positive.expected_behavior: Current status of XNYS (open, half day or closed) for the moment of the test, regular hours 09:30-16:00 New York time, and the next open and close times.

positive.prompt: List the London Stock Exchange's half days and closures in December 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Early closes at 12:30 on 24 and 31 December 2026; closed on 25 December (Christmas Day) and 28 December (Boxing Day, observed for 26 December).

positive.description: Payment-system holidays over a date range
positive.prompt: Which days is TARGET2 closed between 1 December 2026 and 31 January 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: 25 December 2026 (Christmas Day), 26 December 2026 (Christmas Holiday) and 1 January 2027 (New Year's Day).

negative.description: Unrelated request: no calendar data involved, the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported action: the app is read-only and cannot place trades.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 Apple shares as soon as the market opens.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to trade; at most reports the next market open time with market_status.

negative.description: Ambiguous request: the market and date are not specified.
negative.prompt: Is the market open on Friday?
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which exchange (and which Friday) before calling a tool.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; it only reads holiday and business-day data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 17 read-only tools for business days, settlement dates, holidays and live market status.
